description:
### 🚀 Updated App Support

* **Discord:** Add support for `351.11 - Stable`

### ✨ New Features

* **Discord:** Add `Listen along` patch: play a friend's Spotify song on your phone at the same spot and follow along as it changes, thanks to @maayan080
* **Discord:** Add `Fake deafen` patch: look deafened in a call while you can still hear, with your mic muted or working, thanks to @maayan080
* **Discord:** Add `View raw data` patch: hold a message, channel, server, person or role to read and copy its raw data as JSON ([#141](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/141))
* **Discord:** Add `Expand the message bar` patch: a button in the corner of the message bar opens it up tall to read long messages
* **Discord:** Add `Reply without pinging` patch: replies start with the ping off in servers and group DMs, and the @ button turns it on ([#128](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/128))
* **Discord:** Add `Keep media playing` patch: voice messages and audio keep playing in the background with lock screen controls, and videos pop out into a small window ([#134](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/134))
* **Discord:** Add `Compress big files` patch: photos, videos and audio over Discord's size limit are made smaller to fit as you send them ([#136](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/136))
* **Discord:** Add `Download voice messages` patch: a Download button under each voice message saves the recording to Downloads ([#125](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/125))
* **Discord:** Add `Clone emojis and stickers` patch: an Add to a server button in Discord's emoji and sticker sheets ([#125](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/125))
* **Discord:** Add `Show timeout duration` patch: a tag next to a timed-out person's name counts down until they can talk again ([#125](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/125))
* **Discord:** Add `Banners in Do Not Disturb` patch: new messages still slide down at the top in Do Not Disturb, with no sound or buzz ([#125](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/125))
* **Discord:** Add `Full-screen chat in landscape` patch: turn your phone sideways and the chat fills the whole screen ([#125](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/125))
* **Discord:** Add `Edit without "(edited)"` patch: edit your latest message with no tag; it only works while your message is the latest in the chat ([#46](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/46))
* **Discord:** Add `Delete without a trace` patch: your message is blanked a moment before it's deleted, so message loggers keep nothing ([#46](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/46))
* **Discord:** Add `Edit messages on this phone` patch: hold any message and change how it reads, seen only by you, kept in backups and restorable any time ([#129](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/129))
* **Discord:** Add `Leave group DMs silently` patch: leave a group DM without the "left the group" message the others would see ([#129](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/129))
* **Discord:** Add `Preview servers without joining` patch: read a server as a guest from its ID, a link or the Preview button on an invite ([#129](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/129))
* **Discord:** Add `HypeSquad house` patch: join or leave Bravery, Brilliance or Balance from Venus settings ([#129](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/129))
* **Discord:** Add `Custom idle time` patch: pick how long Discord waits before setting you to Idle, or never ([#129](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/129))
* **Discord:** Add `Mutual group DMs` patch: a profile lists the group DMs you share with that person ([#129](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/129))
* **Discord:** Add `Fast delete channels` patch: delete a channel without the confirmation or from its hold menu, with no undo ([#129](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/129))
* **Discord:** Add `Pause invites` patch: hold a server's icon to pause or resume its invites for 1, 6 or 24 hours ([#129](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/129))
* **Discord:** Add `Platform spoof` patch: show as desktop, web or console instead of mobile, with a warning that Discord doesn't allow it ([#129](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/129))
* **Discord - Translate messages:** Pick languages to never translate, so their messages stay as written even with automatic translation on ([#124](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/124))
* **Discord - Account switcher:** Get phone notifications from every saved account, each labeled with its account ([#126](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/126))
* **Discord - Account switcher:** Same theme on every account keeps your theme and Nitro theme when you switch accounts
* **Discord - Keep deleted messages:** A Message log, a No limit option, and Dismiss message and Remove edit history links in chat ([#130](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/130))
* **Discord - User activity notifications:** An Activity log of the status changes, typing and messages of the people you watch ([#130](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/130))
* **Discord - Bulk delete messages:** Your selection follows you across chats, servers and DMs, with a Review sheet before deleting
* **Discord - Remove anything:** Remove rows and quick reactions from a message's hold menu ([#131](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/131))
* **Discord - Venus settings:** Troubleshooting on the About page, with Debug logging, log export and a crash screen that shows what went wrong

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Discord - Account switcher:** Fixed importing accounts signing you out later, because the last imported account's token replaced the one in use ([#137](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/137))
* **Discord - Account switcher:** Fixed switching to an account whose saved sign-in had stopped working signing you out of every account ([#137](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/137))
* **Discord - Account switcher:** Fixed removing a saved account signing you out when it held the token you were using ([#137](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/137))
* **Discord - Unlock Nitro themes:** Fixed a Nitro theme picked without Nitro being lost after switching to another account and back
* **Discord - Complete badges automatically:** Fixed game time and Add hours reaching every saved account instead of only the one it was turned on in
* **Discord - Translate messages:** Fixed some translated messages showing blank, and English messages being shown as translations from another language
* **Discord - Translate messages:** Fixed translating a message stripping the color, title, fields and images from forwarded embeds, even after restarting ([#142](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/142))
* **Discord - Pastel name colors:** Fixed a bot's name losing its role color and getting a pastel one after someone used its application command, even with Replace role colors off ([#144](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/144))
* **Discord - Bulk delete messages:** Fixed selection circles staying on kept deleted messages after deleting finished or was cancelled ([#138](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/138))
* **Discord - Read all button:** Fixed the pill's label shrinking to nothing on phones with a fractional display density
* **Discord - Fix link previews:** Fixed X's new `?a=` share tracker going out with fixed X links

### 🔧 Improvements

* **Discord - Fix link previews:** Each site gets its own settings sheet with only what its service supports, replacing the page-wide Post style, Translate posts, Dark Tumblr posts and Remove tracking options
* **Discord - Custom branding:** No longer offered for root mount installs, where Android keeps the stock app's package and icon ([#121](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/121))
* **Discord - Venus settings:** Tons of UI changes across settings, including a single Add account row in Account switcher, tidier option rows and a cleaner Who to watch section

### ⚡ Performance Improvements

* **Discord:** Over 30 Venus hooks across features skip extra work on every call, running 1.2 to 2.5 times faster
* **Discord - Keep deleted messages:** Chats with kept deleted messages sort about 1.4 times faster
* **Discord - Remove anything:** Profile menus, server sheets and settings rows do much less work while they're drawn

patches.name: Account switcher
patches.description: Switch between multiple Discord accounts from the You tab, your profile bar or Settings.

patches.name: Alert when you're removed
patches.description: Get a heads-up when a friend unfriends you, or a server kicks or bans you. Based on RemovedConnectionAlerts by iyu46.

patches.name: Always trust links and files
patches.description: Opens links and files without Discord's "Are you sure?" warnings. Based on AlwaysTrust by zt and Trwy.

patches.name: Anonymous file names
patches.description: Files you send get a random name instead of the one on your phone. Based on Anonymous File Names by k1ng_op.

patches.name: Banners in Do Not Disturb
patches.description: New messages still pop up at the top while you're on Do Not Disturb, without a sound.

patches.name: Bring back Tenor GIFs
patches.description: Tenor GIFs show in Discord's GIF picker again, mixed with Discord's own or on their own. Inspired by BringBackTenor by Livie.

patches.name: Bulk delete messages
patches.description: Select multiple messages and delete them all at once, in one chat or across channels, servers and DMs.

patches.name: Clean channel names
patches.description: Removes emoji and symbols from channel names, and can show spaces instead of dashes.

patches.name: Clone emojis and stickers
patches.description: Tap a custom emoji or sticker in chat to add it to one of your servers. Based on ExpressionCloner by Ven.

patches.name: Complete Quests automatically
patches.description: Finishes video, Play and Activity Quests in the background. Discord may pause Quests on accounts that do this.

patches.name: Complete badges automatically
patches.description: Plays real PC games in the background, up to 3 at once, toward your Hours Played and Unique Games Played badges.

patches.name: Compress big files
patches.description: Photos, videos and audio over Discord's file size limit are made smaller to fit as you send them, instead of being refused.

patches.name: Copy profile bios
patches.description: Hold a bio to select and copy it.

patches.name: Custom branding
patches.description: Installs Venus as its own app next to the normal Discord app, with the name, color and icon you pick. It starts signed out and keeps its own settings. Notifications work in both.

options.description: Type the name shown under the icon on your home screen and in your app list.
Type any name made of lowercase words joined by dots, like com.discord.venus. A name other than com.discord installs Venus next to the normal Discord app. Type com.discord to replace Discord instead.
The color behind the logo, to tell the two apps apart at a glance. Leave empty for Discord's blurple.
Replaces Discord's logo with your own square picture (PNG, JPG or WebP). Icon color still shows through any transparent parts. Leave empty to keep Discord's logo.

patches.name: Custom idle time
patches.description: Choose how long Discord waits before setting you to Idle, or never. Discord's own time is 10 minutes.

patches.name: Custom themes
patches.description: Install color themes from a link and switch between them. Works with Revenge and Vendetta themes.

patches.name: Delete without a trace
patches.description: Blanks your message before deleting it, so message loggers on other clients keep nothing.

patches.name: Disable advertising identifiers
patches.description: Stops Discord and AppsFlyer from reading your Google advertising ID. Always on once patched.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Discord's usage tracking and the analytics events it uploads. Always on once patched.

patches.name: Disable crash reporting
patches.description: Stops crash reports, screenshots and system logs from being sent to Sentry. Always on once patched.

patches.name: Disable install attribution
patches.description: Stops AppsFlyer from tracking how you installed the app. Some invite links that open before install may not work.

patches.name: Disable telemetry and touch logging
patches.description: Stops performance tracking, per-screen smoothness stats and records of what you tap. Always on once patched.

patches.name: Double-tap to reply
patches.description: Double-tap a message to reply, or your own to edit it. Triple-tap your own to delete it. Based on Geastures+ by kmmiio99o.

patches.name: Download voice messages
patches.description: A Download button under each voice message saves it to your phone. Based on VoiceDownload by puv.

patches.name: Edit messages on this phone
patches.description: Hold any message and change how it reads to you. Only you see the change.

patches.name: Edit servers locally
patches.description: Give any server your own name and icon. Only you see them. Based on EditServers by mwittrien.

patches.name: Edit without "(edited)"
patches.description: Edit a message without the "(edited)" tag. Only works while your message is the latest one in the chat: Venus sends the new text as a new message and deletes the old one. Older messages are edited the normal way.

patches.name: Expand the message bar
patches.description: Adds a button to the top right of the message bar that opens it up tall, so you can see much more of what you're typing.

patches.name: Fake deafen
patches.description: Look deafened in a call while you can still hear. Choose whether your mic stays muted.

patches.name: Fast delete channels
patches.description: Delete a channel without the confirmation, or hold it and tap Delete channel in its menu. Needs Manage Channels. There is no undo.

patches.name: Favourite any image or video
patches.description: Star any image or video to keep it in your GIF favourites.

patches.name: Fix link previews
patches.description: Links to X, Instagram, TikTok, Tumblr and more show the post. Links you send go through an embed service like FxTwitter, without tracking, and X and Bluesky posts can be translated. Inspired by FixEmbed by the ShiggyCord team.

patches.name: Fix unknown mentions
patches.description: @unknown-user mentions are looked up and show the person's name. Based on ValidUser by fshin, o.oer and kmmiio99o.

patches.name: Full-screen chat in landscape
patches.description: Chat fills the screen sideways. Swipe from the left for servers and channels.

patches.name: Hide blocked or ignored messages
patches.description: Removes the "blocked messages" and "ignored messages" rows from chat, and can hide replies to them too. From Rain.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Others won't see when you're typing. You still see when they are.

patches.name: HypeSquad house
patches.description: Join or leave a HypeSquad house (Bravery, Brilliance or Balance) from Venus settings. Discord limits how often you can change house.

patches.name: Icon packs
patches.description: Replace Discord's icons with community icon packs or a custom icon pack link. Works with Themes+ icon packs.

patches.name: Jump to first message
patches.description: A button to go straight to the start of a chat, channel or thread.

patches.name: Keep Bluetooth audio clear in calls
patches.description: Headphones stay in music quality in calls. Your phone's mic picks up your voice.

patches.name: Keep deleted messages
patches.description: Deleted messages stay in chat, outlined in red, and edited messages show what they said before. Can be kept after restarting.

patches.name: Keep media playing
patches.description: Voice messages and audio keep playing when you leave Discord or turn off the screen, and videos pop out into a small window.

patches.name: Leave group DMs silently
patches.description: Leave group DMs without the "left the group" message. Based on SilentLeave by coder.gg.

patches.name: Listen along
patches.description: Play what a friend is listening to on Spotify, from their profile. Needs Spotify Premium.

patches.name: Load full-quality images
patches.description: Pictures in chat and full screen load as uploaded, not as Discord's smaller, compressed copy, and profile pictures stay sharp. Based on Uncompressed Discord Images by Knewest and HighResProfileImages by Kawtious.

patches.name: Material You colors
patches.description: Colors Discord to match your wallpaper, in light and dark. Wallpaper colors need Android 12 or newer.

patches.name: Message highlights
patches.description: Pick bar width and colors for replies, mentions and deleted messages.

patches.name: Mutual group DMs
patches.description: Profiles show the group DMs you share with that person.

patches.name: Pastel name colors
patches.description: Names without a role color get a soft pastel one.

patches.name: Pause invites
patches.description: Hold a server's icon to pause or resume its invites for a while, to stop a raid. Needs Manage Server.

patches.name: Platform spoof
patches.description: Show as desktop, web or console instead of mobile. Discord doesn't allow this and it could put your account at risk. Use at your own risk.

patches.name: Preview servers without joining
patches.description: Open a server from its ID or invite link and read it without joining. Based on GuildLurk by fshin.

patches.name: Read all button
patches.description: A button under Direct Messages that marks servers, DMs or both as read.

patches.name: Remove anything
patches.description: Tap a button you never use to remove it, right where it is: turn on removal mode, then tap the red X on the voice message, attach, gift, call, video, search, Quests, Shop or Nitro buttons, the Quests banner, attach menu items, message menu rows and quick reactions, profile menu items, Settings rows and more. Bring them back any time in Venus.

patches.name: Reply without pinging
patches.description: Replies start with the ping off, so nobody gets pinged unless you turn it on.

patches.name: Send Nitro stickers and emojis as links
patches.description: Sends Nitro emojis and stickers as links that show as the image.

patches.name: Send audio as voice messages
patches.description: Audio files are sent as voice messages. Android 10 or newer.

patches.name: Send long messages
patches.description: Type past the character limit. Long messages are sent in parts, split between lines or words. Based on SplitLargeMessages by sunnie.

patches.name: Server info
patches.description: Hold a server's icon to see its details, boosts and friends there. Based on ServerInfo by fshin.

patches.name: Show device indicators
patches.description: Desktop, mobile, web, console or VR icons next to names, colored by status.

patches.name: Show file sizes when attaching
patches.description: Photos and videos in the picker show their size.

patches.name: Show hidden channels
patches.description: Channels you can't open appear with a lock. Only their name and dates show, not messages.

patches.name: Show owner and mod tags
patches.description: Shows an Owner, Admin, Manager or Mod tag next to people's names in chat. Based on StaffTag by mwittrien.

patches.name: Show timeout duration
patches.description: A tag next to timed-out people says how long until they can talk again. Based on ShowTimeoutDuration by Ven.

patches.name: Skip delete confirmation
patches.description: Messages and link previews are removed right away, with no "Are you sure?". It can't be undone.

patches.name: Skip pin confirmation
patches.description: Pins and unpins messages without asking first. Based on NoConfirmPin by Skamt.

patches.name: Tap mentions to open profiles
patches.description: Tap an @mention in the message bar to see who it is. Based on ClickableMentions by mwittrien.

patches.name: Translate messages
patches.description: Messages in other languages show in yours. Their text is sent to Google Translate, without your account.

patches.name: Unlock Discord experiments
patches.description: Adds Dev Tools to Settings, to try features Discord is still testing. Only on this phone. Based on Experiments by maisy.

patches.name: Unlock Nitro themes
patches.description: Use Discord's gradient themes in Settings > Appearance without Nitro. Only this phone sees them.

patches.name: Unlock app icons
patches.description: Use any Discord app icon in Settings without Nitro.

patches.name: Use your phone's emojis
patches.description: In chat, reactions and the emoji picker, or from an emoji font you import.

patches.name: Use your phone's font
patches.description: Replaces Discord's font everywhere with your phone's or one you import. Android 9 or newer.

patches.name: User activity notifications
patches.description: Shows a notice when chosen friends or users change status, start typing or send a message. Based on UserNotif by cywrx and coder.gg.

patches.name: User and server reviews
patches.description: Read and write reviews on profiles and servers, from the community ReviewDB service (manti.vendicated.dev).

patches.name: Venus button on profile bar
patches.description: A shortcut to Venus settings, next to the notifications bell.

patches.name: Venus settings
patches.description: Adds Venus to Discord's settings, where you turn each feature on or off, in your language. Needed by every feature.

patches.name: View raw data
patches.description: Hold a message, channel, server, person or role to read its raw data as JSON and copy it. Email and phone number are left out.

patches.name: Voice channel options
patches.description: Choose the volume, audio output and sounds for voice channels.

* **Discord - Read all button:** Fixed the pill's label shrinking to nothing on phones with a fractional display density
* **Discord - Fix link previews:** Fixed X's new `?a=` share tracker going out with fixed X links

### 🔧 Improvements

* **Discord - Fix link previews:** Each site gets its own settings sheet with only what its service supports, replacing the page-wide Post style, Translate posts, Dark Tumblr posts and Remove tracking options
* **Discord - Custom branding:** No longer offered for root mount installs, where Android keeps the stock app's package and icon ([#121](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/121))
* **Discord - Venus settings:** Tons of UI changes across settings, including a single Add account row in Account switcher, tidier option rows and a cleaner Who to watch section

### ⚡ Performance Improvements

* **Discord:** Over 30 Venus hooks across features skip extra work on every call, running 1.2 to 2.5 times faster
* **Discord - Keep deleted messages:** Chats with kept deleted messages sort about 1.4 times faster
* **Discord - Remove anything:** Profile menus, server sheets and settings rows do much less work while they're drawn
repoDescription: Independent Morphe patches for Discord: attachment file sizes, custom voice messages, and runtime controls.
